subject: Add an information criterion for predictor selection (7.5)
description:
7.5 names two INVALID approaches explicitly: dropping a predictor from a scatterplot ('This is invalid') and dropping by p > 0.05 ('also invalid... statistical significance does not always indicate predictive value').

Recommended instead: 'AICc, AIC, or CV... each of which has forecasting as their objective... we use the AICc'. Adjusted R-squared is 'less suitable for forecasting'. Backwards stepwise and best-subsets are sanctioned. Warning: 'any procedure involving selecting predictors first will invalidate the assumptions behind the p-values.'

SCAN_LOG: 'The repo tunes on WMAPE and computes no information criterion.'

THE FREE HALF -- do this even if the AICc work is cut. The repo's weighted-distribution rejection SURVIVES 7.5: it was rejected because measured error rose in three of four categories, which IS a predictive criterion. 7.5 CONFIRMS that decision, and it currently stands unsourced in the prose. A free defensive citation.

Modelling-side; no matrix rebuild.
